title: Playable version of canceled Portal prequel F-Stop leaks
excerpt: A nearly complete, playable version of the canceled Portal prequel F-Stop has been put together by leakers using recently shared game files.
body_html:
A fully playable version of the canceled Portal prequel known as F-Stop has surfaced online after being pieced together by leakers. The majority of the game's assets originated from a large 12-terabyte leak that occurred in August.

While that initial leak lacked the game code and map data needed to make the title playable, those remaining components reportedly appeared on the Valve Cut Content Discord server. This final addition enabled the creation of a nearly complete version of the project.
